thread:
Aisha: postmortem follow-up  we keep getting noisy 502/5xx pages during canary deploys. short plan: collapse host-level spikes, add a dedupe window, suppress pages during scheduled deploys, and publish a night/weekend paging matrix. owners below, pls ack with ETA.
Tom: I can take prometheus rules + grouping. plan: group by instance+job and add a 6m dedupe_window. will open a staging PR by Wed.
Renee: Ill own paging policy + suppression tags. plan: page only for severity=critical OR for >=10m, add `no_page` label for warnings, and `suppress_during: deploy_window`. draft by Thu.
ops-bot: Automated: pattern detected  8 deploy-correlated 5xx events in last 14d. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/alerts/5xx-deploy-pattern
Tom: quick prometheus snippet for staging (will test):
```
alert: Outbound5xxBurst
expr: increase(http_responses_total{status=~"5..",route!="/healthz"}[5m]) > 45
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: warning
  dedupe_window: "6m"
  group_by: "job,instance"
annotations:
  runbook: "https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/runbooks/5xx-burst.md"
```
Renee: paging matrix sketch: 00:00-08:00 -> single pager; 08:00-24:00 -> full rotation. page only when `severity=critical` OR `for >= 10m`. include escalation after 15m unacked. will post doc and a short PR to infra by Thu.
Miguel: Ill update runbooks and add a playbook for "502 storm" with queries to correlate deploy events. ETA next Tue.
Aisha: created GH issue #1012 to track (rules + paging + runbook): https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/1012. assigning tasks: Tom (rules, due: Wed COB), Renee (paging policy, due: Thu COB), Miguel (runbook, due: next Tue). pls ack.
Tom: acked. will include staging test and rollback notes.
Renee: acked. will post draft in channel for feedback.
Miguel: acked. will attach example queries to the GH issue.
Aisha: Ill run weekly follow-ups till closed. if anyone hits blockers ping me or @pagerduty. :white_check_mark:
